capabilities.title: Meta-prompt that scaffolds a full self-improving agent operating system
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README: build harness or greenfield agent OS with measurable milestones
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a shipped intelligence dashboard, not a generator for separate agent OS repos; extract patterns only.

capabilities.title: Reader contract, build order, and first-milestone discipline for long prompts
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES, BUILD ORDER, FIRST MILESTONE DEFINITION
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Nexus-native 5-rule reader contract injected into every agent system prompt via buildSystemPrompt. Covers profile-first read, explicit build order, first-milestone naming, blocker surfacing, and milestone confirmation.

capabilities.title: Reliability math, verification gates, and harness engineering requirements
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README RELIABILITY MATH AND HARNESS ENGINEERING section
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Nexus uses eval-agent-runtime, verify gates, and runtime authority receipts instead of vendoring the meta-prompt.

capabilities.title: Transparent durable state instead of hidden memory tricks
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README design bet: transparent state model over hidden memory
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Handoff, episodic memory, and IndexedDB memory are explicit operator-visible stores.

capabilities.title: Unified loop for browser, desktop, research, and long-horizon projects
capabilities.sourceEvidence: README target task list spanning browser, desktop, research, and operations
capabilities.reason: Nexus is the intelligence workspace itself, not a general-purpose desktop-control or browser-control operating system; research and protected project tools remain bounded native capabilities.
